item.title: Singer Trey Songz arrested after alleged altercation at New York nightclub

item.title: Court nullifies impeachment of Wale Adedayo as Ijebu east LG chair, awards N30m damages
item.description: The Ogun state high court has nullified the suspension and impeachment of Wale Adedayo as chairman of Ijebu east LGA. In a judgment delivered on December 10, Catherine Ogunsanya, the presiding judge, held that the councillors in the Ijebu east legislative council did not follow the laid down rule pertaining to impeachment of the LGA chairperson, stipulated in Ogun State Local Government Law. item.title: Gunmen ambush police patrol, ‘kill officer, two residents’ in Nasarawa
item.description: Gunmen have reportedly killed a police officer and two residents during an ambush on a patrol team in Doma LGA of Nasarawa state. Zagazola Makama, a counter-insurgency publication focused on the Lake Chad region, said the attack occurred at about 6:30 pm on Sunday along Ajimaka village road, onwards to Rukubi town. item.title: Tinubu in closed-door meeting with service chiefs
item.description: President Bola Tinubu is currently holding a closed-door meeting with the Service Chiefs at the Aso Rock Presidential Villa in Abuja. This is Tinubu’s first meeting with the military high command since he swore in General Christopher Musa (retd) as the new Minister of Defence on December 4. The meeting comes as 115 students kidnapped from a Catholic boarding school in November remain in captivity. item.description: As the 2027 general elections draw near, the Chief Justice of Nigeria (CJN), Justice Kudirat Kekere-Ekun has warned Judges in the country against issuance of conflicting orders or abuse of ex-parte applications in the pre-election disputes that may be brought to them. item.title: My alliance with Buhari removed sitting president, Jonathan – Tinubu recounts
item.description: President Bola Tinubu on Monday disclosed how he built a coalition with the late former President Muhammadu Buhari. Tinubu said the coalition he built with the late Buhari led to the removal of a former President. Buhari, Tinubu and the All Progressives Congress had worked against the reelection of former President Goodluck Jonathan in 2015.
